title: Protocol for Use with Standard Insert Libraries (370-420 bp)
author: New England Biolabs
materials: On ice, add the following components to the deaminated DNA: A B 1 COMPONENT VOLUME 2 Deaminated DNA (Step 62) 20 µl 3 EM-seq Index Primer*, ** 5 µl 4 (blue) NEBNext Q5U Master Mix 25 µl 5 Total Volume 50 µl *Refer to Section 3 in the manual at NEB.com for barcode pooling guidelines. **EM-seq primers are supplied in tubes in NEB #E7120S or as a 96 Unique Dual Index Primers Pairs Plate in NEB #E7120L.

steps.title: Combine Genomic and Control DNA
steps.instruction: Combine 10–200 ng of genomic DNA (in 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1X TE, or low TE) with control DNAs in a total volume of 50 µl.

substeps.instruction: Add 48 µl of gDNA
Add 1 µl of Unmethylated Lambda Control DNA
Add 1 µl of CpG methylated pUC19 Control DNA
Refer to Table 1.1 for specific control dilutions based on DNA input (10 ng vs 200 ng) and sequencing depth (Pre-sequencing 2-4M reads vs Deep Sequencing 100-150M reads)

steps.title: Fragment DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the 50 µl genomic DNA and control DNA mixture to an average size of ~300 bp (for a 370–420 bp final library) using a device like Covaris. Do not use enzymatic fragmentation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50 µl of sheared DNA to a new PCR tube for End Prep

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: On ice, mix the following components in a sterile nuclease-free PCR tube (Total Volume: 60 µl):

substeps.instruction: 50 µl Sheared DNA
7 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
3 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: On ice, add the following components directly to the End Prep reaction mixture (Total Volume: 93.5 µl):

substeps.instruction: 60 µl End Prep reaction mixture
2.5 µl NEBNext EM-seq Adaptor
1 µl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer
30 µl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix

steps.title: Mix Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the viscous Ligation Master Mix to ensure efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Set a 100 µL or 200 µL pipette to 80 µL and pipette the volume up and down at least 10 times
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid

steps.title: Ligation Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the following program in a thermal cycler with the heated lid off:

substeps.instruction: 15 minutes at 20°C
Hold at 4°C

steps.title: First Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend
Add 110 µl (~1.1X) of beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at Room Temperature
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant
Wash twice: add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant
Remove all visible liquid after the second wash using a p10 tip
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes (beads should remain dark brown and glossy)
Elute by adding 29 µL of Elution Buffer (white)
Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at Room Temperature
Quick spin if necessary, place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until clear), and transfer 28 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube

steps.title: Prepare TET2 Buffer
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the TET2 Reaction Buffer Supplement powder (centrifuge before use).

substeps.instruction: Option A (E7120S/E7120G): Add 100 µL of TET2 Reaction Buffer to the supplement
Option B (E7120L): Add 400 µL of TET2 Reaction Buffer to the supplement
Store reconstituted buffer at -20°C (discard after 4 months)

steps.title: TET2 Oxidation Reaction
steps.instruction: On ice, add the following components to the EM-seq adaptor ligated DNA (Total Volume: 45 µl):

substeps.instruction: 28 µl EM-seq adaptor ligated DNA
10 µl TET2 Reaction Buffer
1 µl Oxidation Supplement
1 µl DTT
1 µl Oxidation Enhancer
4 µl TET2
Vortex and centrifuge briefly

steps.title: Initiate Oxidation with Fe(II)
steps.instruction: Dilute the Fe(II) solution and add it to the reaction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 500 mM Fe(II) Solution: add 1 µL to 1249 µL of water (use immediately)
Add 5 µl of Diluted Fe(II) Solution to 45 µl of Reaction Mixture (Total Volume: 50 µl)
Mix by vortexing or pipetting up and down 10 times, then centrifuge briefly

steps.title: Oxidation Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the following program in a thermal cycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45°C or on:

substeps.instruction: 1 hour at 37°C
Hold at 4°C

steps.title: Stop Oxidation
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to ice and add 1 µL of Stop Reagent (yellow) to 50 µl of Oxidized DNA (Total Volume: 51 µl). Mix thoroughly and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Stop Reagent Incubation
steps.instruction: Run the following program in a thermal cycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45°C or on:

substeps.instruction: 30 minutes at 37°C
Hold at 4°C

steps.title: Second Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the oxidized DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend
Add 90 µl (1.8X) of beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at Room Temperature
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant
Wash twice: add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant
Remove all visible liquid after the second wash using a p10 tip
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes (beads should remain dark brown and glossy)
Elute by adding 17 µL of Elution Buffer (white)
Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at Room Temperature
Quick spin if necessary, place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until clear), and transfer 16 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube

steps.title: DNA Denaturation
steps.instruction: Denature the 16 µL of oxidized DNA using one of the following options:

substeps.instruction: Option A (Formamide): Add 4 µL Formamide to 16 µL DNA. Vortex/mix, centrifuge, and incubate at 85°C for 10 minutes in a thermal cycler (lid ≥ 105°C). Immediately place on ice for ~2 minutes.
Option B (NaOH): Add 4 µL 0.1 N NaOH to 16 µL DNA. Vortex/mix, centrifuge, and incubate at 50°C for 10 minutes in a thermal cycler (lid ≥ 105°C). Immediately place on ice for ~2 minutes.

steps.title: APOBEC Deamination Reaction
steps.instruction: On ice, add the following components to the denatured DNA (Total Volume: 100 µl):

substeps.instruction: 20 µl Denatured DNA
68 µl Nuclease-free water
10 µl APOBEC Reaction Buffer
1 µl BSA
1 µl APOBEC

steps.title: APOBEC Incubation
steps.instruction: Run the following program in a thermal cycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45°C or on:

substeps.instruction: Hold at 4°C

steps.title: Third Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the deaminated DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend
Add 100 µl (1.0X) of beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at Room Temperature
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant
Wash twice: add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant
Remove all visible liquid after the second wash using a p10 tip
Air-dry beads for up to 1.5 minutes (do not over-dry)
Elute by adding 21 µL of Elution Buffer (white) or 1XTE/Low TE/0.1XTE for long term storage
Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at Room Temperature
Quick spin if necessary, place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until clear), and transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification in a thermal cycler with the heated lid set to 105°C:

substeps.instruction: Initial Denaturation: 98°C for 30 seconds (1 cycle)
Denaturation: 98°C for 10 seconds
Annealing: 62°C for 30 seconds
Extension: 65°C for 60 seconds
Cycle count: 8 cycles for 10 ng input; 5-6 cycles for 50 ng input; 4 cycles for 200 ng input
Final Extension: 65°C for 5 minutes (1 cycle)
Hold: 4°C

steps.title: Final Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup of the PCR libraries using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend
Add 45 µl (0.9X) of beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at Room Temperature
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant
Wash twice: add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant
Remove all visible liquid after the second wash using a p10 tip
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes (do not over-dry)
Elute by adding 21 µL of Elution Buffer (white)
Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at Room Temperature
Quick spin if necessary, place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until clear), and transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube

steps.title: Library Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Determine size distribution and concentration using a Bioanalyzer or TapeStation. Sequence on an Illumina platform using 2 x 76 base or 2 x 100 base reads.
